gloss: to regulate, to crack down on

definitions.gloss: to crack down on, to regulate, to control
definitions.explanation: To enforce rules or laws to suppress illegal or improper activities.
To oversee operations or staff in an organization.

examples.japanese: {警察|けいさつ}は{違法駐車|いほうちゅうしゃ}を{厳|きび}しく{取|と}り{締|し}まっている。
examples.english: The police are strictly cracking down on illegal parking.

examples.japanese: ネットでの{著作権侵害|ちょさくけんしんがい}を{取|と}り{締|し}まる{法律|ほうりつ}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Laws are needed to regulate copyright infringement on the internet.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{会社|かいしゃ}の{取|と}り{締|し}まり{役|やく}を{務|つと}めている。
examples.english: He serves as a company director.
examples.notes: 取り締まり役 = company director (person who manages)

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Compound verb: {取|と}る + {締|し}まる. Pattern: Xを{取|と}り{締|し}まる (crack down on X / regulate X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing enforcement. {取|と}り{締|し}まっている = 'is regulating' or 'is cracking down on.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{違反|いはん}を{取|と}り{締|し}まる (crack down on violations)
・{厳|きび}しく{取|と}り{締|し}まる (strictly regulate)
・{取|と}り{締|し}まり (regulation, crackdown - noun form)
・{取|と}り{締|し}まり{役|やく} (company director)

NOTE: The noun form {取|と}り{締|し}まり is very common, especially in {取|と}り{締|し}まり{役|やく} (director) in business contexts.
